LSTM Encoder-Decoder: lstm_seq2seq

Sequence-to-sequence model for CNR prediction. Encoder compresses CNR + stim features history → hidden state. Decoder takes hidden state + future stim features → predicted CNR.
param value
source real
hidden_dim 32
num_layers 1
history_len 10
future_len 10
lr 0.001
epochs 20
batch_size 256
patience 10
dry_run True

Data: 26165 trajectories × 20 timepoints (real) Encoder input: CNR + 4 stim features (u_t, m_t, ewma_slow, s_cum) over 10 history steps Decoder input: 4 stim features over 10 future steps → predicts CNR Train: 2000 windows | Val: 2000 | Test: 2000
Model: LSTM Seq2Seq | encoder_in=5 decoder_in=4 | hidden=32 layers=1 | 9,889 params | mps
Training complete in 3s — 20 epochs
